title: The Frequency Beta entry at /join is one centered card that asks one question per slide and builds up the answers as it goes

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: re-design the beta onboarding to be more centered, larger and clear, as a progressive slide that reveals the next input and builds in complexity as they progress. Follows SCAN-879.

detail: Under SITE_DESIGN=frequency the bare /join Beta entry (SCAN-879) drops its two-pane photo-and-panel layout for one centered glass card on the Frequency stage, with the side's photo as a soft blurred full-bleed backdrop and the site-fx Join sphere still behind it (the stage keeps .jx-panel). It asks one question per slide, each sliding in from the side it came from: 1 What should we call you? (name), 2 Where should we send your link? (email; Send my link is where the existing stashPendingInduction park, captureLead row and sendSignupLink send happen, and stepping back and forward with the same address does not send twice), 3 Add a face (optional photo, parked under fq_pending_avatar as before), 4 Where are you? (Turn on location through getBrowserPosition and reversePlace, typed-town typeahead as the fallback with arrow-key selection, optional; the town is re-parked and added to the lead), 5 Check your email (Send it again, Use a different email). Earlier answers sit as chips above the current question, each one a button back to its slide; a thin progress bar and a 1 / 5 count show the way; Back is on every slide after the first; Enter advances; focus lands on each new slide's input; each slide is a region labelled by its question and an aria-live line announces the step. Under prefers-reduced-motion the slides and chips swap without moving. Larger type (question up to the display-l step, 64px inputs at the h3 size, 60px buttons). A resumed browser (parked name and handle) still reopens on the photo slide. Same server actions and data, no SQL; DAWN and the /join?seq=, ?persona=, ?next= links are unchanged. Styles stay in the hand-kept site-pages-b.css (.jb-*), --fq- tokens only.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const j=r('components/frequency/site/pages/join/frequency-join.tsx');const c=r('app/themes/frequency/site-pages-b.css');const bad=[];for(const k of ['What should we call you?','Where should we send your link?','Add a face','Where are you?','Check your email'])if(!j.includes(k))bad.push('no slide asking '+k);for(const k of ['jb-chips','aria-live','role=\"progressbar\"','jb-back','sendSignupLink','stashPendingInduction','reversePlace','fq_pending_avatar'])if(!j.includes(k))bad.push('the beta entry lacks '+k);if(j.includes('jx-art'))bad.push('still the two-pane photo layout');if(!/prefers-reduced-motion[^}]*jb-slide/.test(c)||!c.includes('@keyframes jbIn'))bad.push('no slide motion with a reduced-motion swap');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-888: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
